description: Run the tests; on failure, search the error and apply a fix, then re-verify. Loop bounded by a fix-attempt counter. Green tests -> commit; give up -> escalate.

nodes.instruction: Run the test suite with run_command (`python -m pytest -q`). Then output a single JSON object: {"tests_passed": true or false, "error_summary": "<short reason if failed, empty if passed>"}. Base tests_passed STRICTLY on the actual pytest result, never on your own opinion.
Search the failing test error plus the library versions.
Apply a fix based on the search findings. Do NOT claim tests pass — run_tests is the verifier.
